title: Leo Tolstoy, Anna Karenina recast
author: Salon
note: This whole-book remake includes adultery, a miscarriage, and suicide at the station—exact, not operatic. Period-true to Tolstoy’s ending, written without gore spectacle. Warn the room before you Host it; offer a midpoint pause if needed.
